simple.summary: גִּדְעֹם (Gidʻôm) means Gidom , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 20 45.

definitions.full: H1440. Gidom גִּדְעֹם proper name, of a location marking limit of pursuit of Benjamites by rest of Israel Judg 20:45 .
